Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by their 2025 building permit count using pre-aggregated tract counts, left joining to include zero-permit tracts and ordering by count descending with name as tiebreaker.
sql:
WITH permit_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS building_permit_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_316b0c' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  COALESCE(p.building_permit_count, 0) AS building_permit_count,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN permit_counts p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
ORDER BY building_permit_count DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
